# Workshop repair licence

This licence takes effect on 6 November 2026 between ⟦ORG|Velvet Spindle CIC⟧ (the Owner) and Ms ⟦PERSON|Neri-Lu O'Quen⟧ (the Repairer). The workroom is at ⟦ADDRESS|18 Brindle Mews, Leeds⟧. Access is limited to the rear bench and the locked tool cupboard; the Owner retains possession of every other part of the building.

1. The Repairer may inspect the damaged looms during ordinary working hours. No machine may leave the premises without a written inventory signed by both parties. The licence creates no tenancy and gives no right to display advertising outside.
2. The Owner will supply replacement bearings. The Repairer must photograph each removed component and retain it until acceptance. The agreed price is GBP 840, including consumables, payable within fourteen days of the final inspection.
3. An unsafe electrical connection must be isolated immediately. The Repairer may suspend work while the Owner arranges an independent inspection, with no penalty for that delay.

**Contact:** ⟦EMAIL|neri.lu@velvet-spindle.invalid⟧; telephone ⟦PHONE|+44 7700 900731⟧.

The parties adopt section 3.2 as their inspection procedure. A disagreement about workmanship goes first to a jointly appointed expert in Leeds. The expert may allocate the inspection charge but cannot alter the contract price.

Signed for the Owner: ⟦PERSON|Evin Vossel⟧, workshop coordinator.

Signed by the Repairer: ⟦PERSON|Neri-Lu O'Quen⟧.
